timing: Source corrections completed from immutable cache before topic/embedding interpretation; this is a post-acquisition protocol correction.

collection_rules.lrclib_selection: Exact normalized artist/title; preferred album if supplied, then longest lyrics. Longest is only a heuristic, not editorial validation.
collection_rules.corpus_provider_selection: Manifest preferred_provider only for reviewed override, otherwise first successful provider in declared order.
collection_rules.radio_edits: Not categorically excluded; review against chosen recording/edition.
collection_rules.cleaning: Only strict numeric LRC timestamp prefixes removed. Original narration, order, words and section headings retained.
collection_rules.raw_cache: Files labeled raw are cached provider records after the initial collector processing, not byte-for-byte original HTTP payloads. The 120 cached records were not edited during this correction.
collection_rules.coverage_interpretation: Observed collector responses on this corpus/query strategy, not general API quality. OVH 404 across all 40 requests may reflect service availability and does not prove each song lacks lyrics.

privacy.scope: Current fear/miedo study source, metadata, generated outputs and matching article/static/build files; unrelated historical site artifacts are outside this audit.
privacy.explanation: Conservative reconstruction screen, not a copyright-law threshold. No lyric excerpts are authorized or intentionally exported by this study; shorter fragments and paraphrases still require editorial review.

residual_caveats: Most candidates lack album identity; compilation records and full-versus-radio variants are not exhaustively verified.
Stan, Crazy In Love, Llamando a la Tierra, Miedo and Enrique Iglesias Bailando have one successful provider. Identity/language are compatible; full edition correctness remains provisional.
Bailando chosen for Enrique Iglesias is predominantly Spanish in the language screen; Sean Paul is not an accepted artist alias.
Low sequence agreement can arise from refrain expansion, section boundaries and orthography. It does not by itself imply wrong lyrics.
The 13 word screen is conservative QA, not permission to quote 12 words. No lyric excerpts are intentionally published; shorter matches require human editorial inspection.
